Better links and media in the editor.

### 🚀 Features
- Link cards get their own toolbar.
- Embeds have an open-link button.
- Drag a picture, video or file to move it within the note.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.4.1...v0.4.2](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.4.1...v0.4.2)
